name: Myanmar
summary: Junta airstrikes continue in Rakhine as the Arakan Army presses Sittwe; no major city has fallen
state: Military airstrikes in Rakhine State have killed civilians, including at a maternity clinic in Mrauk-U, and fighting has been reported around Sittwe (DMG; BNI). The Arakan Army has advanced toward Sittwe, but no major city had changed hands as of 7 Nov, so the civil war is rated at sustained intensity.
for_you: Follow FCDO advice against all but essential travel to most of Myanmar.
rubric_hit: Civil war at sustained intensity = Watch; no major city fallen (Alert)

why: A multi-sided civil war affecting 50 million people, with spillover to China, Thailand, India and Bangladesh.
drivers: Resistance offensives, junta airstrikes, Chinese mediation, elections, humanitarian access.
